title: Welcome to BookKraft AI
excerpt: BookKraft AI is a set of ebook formatting tools built for indie authors who want professional results without the software learning curve. Here's what we built and why.
meta_title: Welcome to BookKraft AI — Ebook Formatting Tools for Indie Authors
meta_description: BookKraft AI is a collection of ebook formatting tools built for indie authors. Validate EPUBs, fix Kindle errors, build metadata, and more — no software required.
html:
Welcome to BookKraft AI. If you found your way here, you're probably dealing with some version of the same problem: formatting an ebook is harder than it should be.

You finished writing a book. That's the hard part. Then you discovered that getting it into a format that actually works on Kindle, Apple Books, Kobo, and every other platform is a whole other project — one that requires knowing about EPUB structure, OPF manifests, CSS compatibility, and a dozen other technical things that have nothing to do with writing.

BookKraft AI is a set of tools designed to handle that technical layer so you can focus on publishing.

What BookKraft AI Does

We built sixteen tools that cover the most common ebook formatting problems. Some are free with no account needed. Others are available through a one-time purchase — no subscription, no monthly fee.

The free tools include:

  • EPUB Validator — checks your EPUB against the same rules that KDP, Apple Books, and Kobo use
  • Metadata Builder — generates properly formatted metadata for every publishing platform at once
  • Word Cleanup Checker — scans your .docx file for formatting problems before conversion
  • Cover Checker — verifies your cover image meets KDP and Apple Books size requirements
  • Full Manuscript Mode — converts your .docx or .txt to a valid EPUB 3.0 file in one step

No signup required to use any of these. Open the tool, upload your file or paste your text, get a result.

What We Built For and Why

Most ebook formatting tools fall into two categories: cheap but manual (Sigil, Calibre), or expensive and proprietary (Vellum, Atticus). The cheap tools require significant technical knowledge. The expensive tools lock you into a subscription or a Mac-only ecosystem.

We wanted something in between. Tools that do specific jobs automatically, in the browser, without requiring you to learn EPUB internals or pay monthly for software you only need occasionally.

The EPUB Validator came first, because EPUB validation was the clearest gap. Most authors were finding out their file had problems from a KDP rejection email — not from their tool. We built a validator that shows you the same problems before you upload.

The rest of the tools grew from real questions: how do I fix the TOC KDP keeps rejecting? How do I generate metadata for five platforms at once? How do I clean up a Word manuscript before converting it?

How BookKraft AI Is Different

Everything runs in the browser. You don't install anything. Your files stay on your device — we don't store manuscripts or personal data beyond what's necessary to run the tool.

The AI-powered tools use Claude to understand your manuscript and apply formatting logic that simple rule-based tools can't do. The free tools use in-browser processing — no server, no upload, no privacy concern.

Pricing is one-time. If you buy a plan, you get the tools permanently — there's no subscription that stops working if you miss a payment.

Get Started

If you have an EPUB that's getting rejected, start with the EPUB Validator. It's free, takes about 30 seconds, and will tell you exactly what's wrong.

If you're formatting a book from scratch, start with the Full Manuscript Mode — upload your Word or text file and get a valid EPUB back in one step.

Everything else is on the dashboard when you create an account. The free tools are available without any account at all.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is BookKraft AI free?

Five tools are completely free with no account required. Additional tools are available through a one-time Starter or Pro plan — no subscription, no recurring charges.

Do I need to create an account to use the free tools?

No. The free tools work immediately with no signup. An account is only needed if you want to save your work, use the dashboard, or access paid tools.

Does BookKraft AI store my manuscripts?

The free tools process files entirely in your browser — nothing is uploaded to our servers. The AI-powered tools send your text to the AI for processing but don't store it permanently.

What formats does BookKraft AI output?

Depending on the tool: EPUB 3.0 (the industry standard for ebook distribution), formatted text for KDP direct publishing, and metadata formatted for KDP, Apple Books, IngramSpark, and Draft2Digital.
